title: Tap Dodge: Balancing Failure Tolerance and Bullet Speed Curves
subtitle: A deep dive into the tap dodge mechanic, analyzing hitbox tolerance settings and near-miss feedback to balance failure risk. We also explore constructing bullet speed curves to achieve smooth difficulty progression, providing core design strategies for developers to ensure both responsive controls and long-term player retention.
